## R Markdown

This is an R Markdown document. Markdown is a simple formatting syntax for authoring HTML, PDF, and MS Word documents. For more details on using R Markdown see <http://rmarkdown.rstudio.com>.

When you click the **Knit** button a document will be generated that includes both content as well as the output of any embedded R code chunks within the document. You can embed an R code chunk like this:

```{r cars}

# Generate a generic distribution in log10 readout space
plot_data <- data.frame(
  log_readout = seq(0, 6, length.out = 1500)
) %>%
  mutate(
    cell_count = dnorm(log_readout, mean = 3, sd = 0.8) * 1800
  )

# Sorting boundaries: bottom 5%, bottom 10%, top 10%, and top 5%
bin_boundaries <- qnorm(
  c(0.02, 0.11, 0.89, 0.98),
  mean = 3,
  sd = 0.8
)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
  mutate(
    bin = case_when(
      log_readout <= bin_boundaries[1] ~ "Bin 1",
      log_readout <= bin_boundaries[2] ~ "Bin 2",
      log_readout >= bin_boundaries[4] ~ "Bin 3",
      log_readout >= bin_boundaries[3] ~ "Bin 4",
      TRUE ~ "Not sorted"
    ),
    bin = factor(
      bin,
      levels = c(
    "Bin 1",
    "Bin 2",
        "Not sorted",
    "Bin 3",
    "Bin 4"
      )
    )
  )

# Positions for bin labels
bin_label_positions <- data.frame(
  label = c(
    "Bin 1",
    "Bin 2",
    "Bin 3",
    "Bin 4"
  ),
  log_readout = c(
    mean(c(0, bin_boundaries[1])),
    mean(bin_boundaries[1:2]),
    mean(bin_boundaries[3:4]),
    mean(c(bin_boundaries[4], 6))
  ),
  cell_count = max(plot_data$cell_count) * 0.62
)

cell_sorting_plot <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(x = log_readout, y = cell_count)
) +
  geom_area(aes(fill = bin), alpha = 0.65) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1.4, colour = "#527FB8") +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = bin_boundaries,
    linewidth = 1.1,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = bin_label_positions,
    aes(
      x = log_readout,
      y = cell_count,
      label = label
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "Bin 1" = "#4C78A8",
      "Bin 2" = "#9EC1DE",
      "Not sorted" = "#DCE6F0",
      "Bin 3" = "#F4A582",
      "Bin 4" = "#C94C4C"
    )
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 0:6,
    labels = c(
      "0",
      expression(10^1),
      expression(10^2),
      expression(10^3),
      expression(10^4),
      expression(10^5),
      expression(10^6)
    ),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, max(plot_data$cell_count) * 1.08),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0))
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Sorting",
    x = "Readout",
    y = "Cell count"
  ) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 16) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(
      size = 22,
      face = "bold",
      hjust = 0.5,
      margin = margin(b = 15)
    ),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
    axis.ticks = element_line(linewidth = 0.8),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

cell_sorting_plot

ggsave(
  "/g/steinmetz/link/cell_sorting_four_bins.png",
  cell_sorting_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 5.5,
  dpi = 300,
  bg = "white"
)
```

## Including Plots

You can also embed plots, for example:



```{r stacked_barplots_bcwithqc, echo=FALSE}


# Z:\ corresponds to /g/steinmetz/
base_dir <- "/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis"


PA     = readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "HepG2_dual_rep_PA_mecas/results/MAUDE_Hits.rds"))
DCA    = readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "HepG2_dual_rep_DCA_mecas/results/MAUDE_Hits.rds"))
GALNAC = readRDS(file.path(base_dir, "HepG2_dual_rep_GALNAC_mecas/results/MAUDE_Hits.rds"))
screens <- list(PA = PA, DCA = DCA, GALNAC = GALNAC)
directions <- c("positive", "negative")

# Unique Entrez IDs for each screen and direction
hit_ids <- lapply(screens, function(df) {
  sig <- df[!is.na(df$FDR) & df$FDR <= 0.05 &
            !is.na(df$significanceZ), ]

  list(
    positive = unique(as.character(
      sig$entrez[sig$significanceZ > 0 & !is.na(sig$entrez)]
    )),
    negative = unique(as.character(
      sig$entrez[sig$significanceZ < 0 & !is.na(sig$entrez)]
    ))
  )
})

rows <- list()

for (screen in names(screens)) {
  df <- screens[[screen]]

  for (direction in directions) {
    direction_match <- if (direction == "positive") {
      !is.na(df$significanceZ) & df$significanceZ > 0
    } else {
      !is.na(df$significanceZ) & df$significanceZ < 0
    }

    row_match <- !is.na(df$FDR) & df$FDR <= 0.05 & direction_match
    ids <- unique(as.character(df$entrez[row_match & !is.na(df$entrez)]))
    other_screens <- setdiff(names(screens), screen)

    overlaps <- setNames(rep(NA_integer_, length(screens)),
                         paste0("overlap_", names(screens)))

    for (other in other_screens) {
      overlaps[paste0("overlap_", other)] <-
        length(intersect(ids, hit_ids[[other]][[direction]]))
    }

    shared_all_three <- length(Reduce(
      intersect,
      c(list(ids), lapply(other_screens, function(other) {
        hit_ids[[other]][[direction]]
      }))
    ))

    rows[[length(rows) + 1]] <- data.frame(
      screen = screen,
      direction = direction,
      n_entries = sum(row_match),
      n_unique_entrez = length(ids),
      as.list(overlaps),
      shared_all_three = shared_all_three,
      check.names = FALSE
    )
  }
}

summary_table <- do.call(rbind, rows)
rownames(summary_table) <- NULL
summary_table


```


```{r reads_per_umi_barplot, echo=FALSE}

library(readr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

input_file <- "/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/Jia_CM_prelim/plots/01a_reads_per_umi_distribution_plots/reads_per_umi_distribution.tsv.gz"
output_file <- "/g/steinmetz/link/reads_per_umi_distribution_input_bin.png"

plot_data <- read_tsv(input_file, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  filter(sample == "combined_samples", bin_name == "I")

display_limit <- max(plot_data$display_limit, na.rm = TRUE)

plot_data <- plot_data |>
  filter(count <= display_limit)

p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = count, y = fraction)) +
  geom_col(fill = "#384860", width = 0.85) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq_len(display_limit),
    limits = c(0.5, display_limit + 0.5),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Reads per UMI distribution (first 99% of UMIs)",
    x = "Reads per UMI",
    y = "Fraction of UMIs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.grid.minor = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "grey40", fill = NA)
  )

ggsave(output_file, p, width = 12, height = 7, dpi = 300)
```

```{r Jia_analysis, eval=FALSE}
jia_read_counts <- readRDS("/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/Jia_CM_prelim/rds/count_df.rds")
jia_umi_counts <- readRDS("/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/Jia_CM_prelim/rds_umis/count_df.rds")
library <- readRDS("/g/steinmetz/link/Amplicon_barcode_analysis/library/CM_specific_library.rds")
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)
library(stringr)
library(patchwork)
library(tidytext)

# Helper: guess the sgRNA column in a table
guess_sg_col <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("sgRNA", "sgrna_id", "sgrna_seq", "sgrna")
  hit <- intersect(candidates, colnames(df))
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("No sgRNA column found in data frame.")
  hit[1]
}

# Helper: guess the count column in a table
guess_count_col <- function(df) {
  candidates <- c("count", "counts", "value")
  hit <- intersect(candidates, colnames(df))
  if (length(hit) == 0) stop("No count column found in data frame.")
  hit[1]
}

read_sg_col <- guess_sg_col(jia_read_counts)
umi_sg_col  <- guess_sg_col(jia_umi_counts)
read_ct_col  <- guess_count_col(jia_read_counts)
umi_ct_col   <- guess_count_col(jia_umi_counts)

# Make a common key for joining library <-> count tables.
# Prefer sgrna_id if available; otherwise fall back to sgRNA or sgrna_seq.
library_key_col <- guess_sg_col(library)

# Standardize columns
reads_df <- jia_read_counts %>%
  transmute(
    sgRNA = .data[[read_sg_col]],
    read_count = .data[[read_ct_col]],
    sample = if ("sample" %in% colnames(.)) sample else NA_character_,
    condition = if ("condition" %in% colnames(.)) condition else NA_character_
  )

umis_df <- jia_umi_counts %>%
  transmute(
    sgRNA = .data[[umi_sg_col]],
    umi_count = .data[[umi_ct_col]],
    sample = if ("sample" %in% colnames(.)) sample else NA_character_,
    condition = if ("condition" %in% colnames(.)) condition else NA_character_
  )

# If your library table uses sgrna_id, this join should work directly.
# If not, change `sgRNA` to the appropriate key column in library.
library_df <- library %>%
  rename(
    sgRNA = all_of(library_key_col)
  ) %>%
  select(sgRNA, gene, entrez_id, type, sgrna_seq)

# Join read + UMI counts and add gene
combined_df <- full_join(reads_df, umis_df, by = c("sgRNA", "sample", "condition")) %>%
  left_join(library_df, by = "sgRNA") %>%
  mutate(
    read_count = replace_na(read_count, 0),
    umi_count  = replace_na(umi_count, 0)
  )

# Optional: log transform for nicer plots
combined_df <- combined_df %>%
  mutate(
    log10_read = log10(read_count + 1),
    log10_umi  = log10(umi_count + 1)
  )

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 1) Scatter plot: read count vs UMI count by sgRNA
# ------------------------------------------------------------
p_scatter <- ggplot(combined_df, aes(x = read_count, y = umi_count)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.35, size = 1) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  scale_y_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Read count vs UMI count by sgRNA",
    x = "Read count (log10 scale)",
    y = "UMI count (log10 scale)"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# Optional: add correlation label
cor_val <- cor(combined_df$read_count, combined_df$umi_count, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs")
p_scatter <- p_scatter +
  annotate("text", x = Inf, y = Inf, label = paste0("Spearman rho = ", round(cor_val, 3)),
           hjust = 1.1, vjust = 1.5, size = 4)

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 2) Separate distributions of read and UMI counts
# ------------------------------------------------------------
dist_df <- combined_df %>%
  select(sgRNA, gene, read_count, umi_count) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(read_count, umi_count),
    names_to = "count_type",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    count_type = recode(count_type,
                        read_count = "Read count",
                        umi_count = "UMI count")
  )

p_dist <- ggplot(dist_df, aes(x = count + 1, fill = count_type)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.35) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(
    title = "Count distributions",
    x = "Count + 1 (log10 scale)",
    y = "Density",
    fill = ""
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 3) Lowest 10 sgRNAs by read / UMI count
# ------------------------------------------------------------

low20_sg_df <- combined_df %>%
  select(sgRNA, gene, read_count, umi_count) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(read_count, umi_count),
    names_to = "count_type",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    count_type = recode(count_type,
                        read_count = "Read count",
                        umi_count = "UMI count"),
    label = sgRNA
  ) %>%
  group_by(count_type) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = count, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

p_low20_sg <- ggplot(
  low20_sg_df,
  aes(x = tidytext::reorder_within(label, count, count_type), y = count, fill = count_type)
) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~count_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  labs(
    title = "Lowest 10 sgRNAs by count type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Count"
  ) +
  theme_bw()


# ------------------------------------------------------------
# 4) Lowest 10 genes by aggregated read / UMI count
# ------------------------------------------------------------

gene_df <- combined_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(gene), gene != "") %>%
  filter(type == "targeting") %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(
    read_count = sum(read_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    umi_count  = sum(umi_count, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_sgRNAs   = n_distinct(sgRNA),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

low20_gene_df <- gene_df %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(read_count, umi_count),
    names_to = "count_type",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    count_type = recode(count_type,
                        read_count = "Read count",
                        umi_count = "UMI count")
  ) %>%
  group_by(count_type) %>%
  slice_min(order_by = count, n = 10, with_ties = FALSE) %>%
  ungroup()

p_low20_gene <- ggplot(
  low20_gene_df,
  aes(x = tidytext::reorder_within(gene, count, count_type), y = count, fill = count_type)
) +
  geom_col(show.legend = FALSE) +
  coord_flip() +
  facet_wrap(~count_type, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  tidytext::scale_x_reordered() +
  labs(
    title = "Lowest 10 targeting genes by count type",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Aggregated count"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

# ------------------------------------------------------------
# Combine and print
# ------------------------------------------------------------

print(p_scatter)
print(p_dist)
print(p_low20_sg)
print(p_low20_gene)
```
